jobs.title: Business Operations Intern (Remote)
jobs.description:
About the Role:

Support our RevOps and Partnerships team by keeping CRM data clean and accurate, building workflows and dashboards, running reports, and powering the operational backbone of our webinars and newsletters. High-ownership role with active encouragement to use AI tools to automate repetitive work.

What You’ll Do:

Support end-to-end execution of partnership-led webinars and campaigns, including:

  • Creating LinkedIn and Zoom promotional banners, webinar decks, and presentation assets
  • Managing webinar logistics such as Zoom setup, webinar links, email campaigns, promo codes, and follow-ups
  • Coordinating cross-functional execution with Marketing, Ops, and other internal teams to ensure timely delivery of webinar requirements, including iterating on webinar decks and assets based on stakeholder feedback and evolving requests
  • Maintaining webinar documentation, trackers, and operational processes

Own and support monthly newsletter operations, including:

  • Designing banners and visual assets
  • Organizing and structuring newsletter content
  • Preparing newsletters for distribution and coordinating execution timelines

Support RevOps and CRM operations by:

  • Cleaning, organizing, and maintaining CRM data across systems
  • Routing accounts and leads, deduplicating records, and fixing data inconsistencies
  • Using AI tools and secondary research to enrich lead/account data with actionable insights, while leveraging automation to significantly reduce repetitive manual processes and improve operational efficiency 
  • Building and maintaining dashboards, workflows, and reports to support business visibility and execution

Requirements

About You:

  • Proactive, independent, and comfortable working with minimal supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with a sharp eye for detail.
  • Comfortable with Excel (pivot tables, formulas, basic data work), Canva, and PowerPoint.
  • Already using AI tools to build prompts, workflows, or lightweight agents that cut down repetitive work. You instinctively ask, "Can I automate this?" before doing it manually for the tenth time.

Nice to Have:

  • Prior exposure to a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, etc.)
  • Familiarity with Zoom Webinars or email marketing tools
  • A side project or example of automating something with AI

How to apply for this position?

Please fill out the form with the required details. If your profile is shortlisted, our team will reach out to you via email. If you don't find the emails in your inbox, please check your spam folder.

Tip: Avoid using AI-generated responses. We want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Europe Solutions Consultant, Hotels (Remote)
jobs.description:
About the role:

We’re looking for a Solutions Consultant, Hotels to help scale our presence in the hospitality space. In this high-impact role, you’ll work directly with hotel groups and operators - guiding them from the first sales conversation through onboarding and long-term success with PriceLabs.

You’ll be joining our global Solutions Consulting team with a specific mandate: scaling the hotel segment. That means leading sales conversations, helping clients implement the product effectively, and ensuring their long-term success. We’re looking for someone who thrives on outbound sales, knows how hotel businesses operate, and is excited to help us build this vertical from the ground up. This role is ideal for someone with a deep understanding of hotel operations, a passion for sales, and a drive to scale a fast-growing vertical.

This role is for people who reside in Europe with preference from France, Spain or Portugal and have a work permit.


Compensation: €40,000 – €55,000 per year (total compensation, including base salary and variable pay), depending on experience and location.


What you’ll do:

  • Proactively drive new business within the hotel segment by actively sourcing, engaging, and converting prospective clients - this is a hands-on sales role with a strong outbound focus
  • Manage the full sales lifecycle for hotel clients, from outreach and consultative demos to onboarding, implementation, and early results
  • Guide hotel partners in adopting PriceLabs effectively, ensuring they realize meaningful revenue impact and stay engaged with the platform
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with hotel operators and management groups, serving as their go-to advisor for maximizing platform value
  • Identify and execute opportunities to grow accounts, increase adoption across properties, and support ongoing client success
  • Work closely with Sales Ops and Growth to refine our messaging, outreach, and GTM motion for the hotel segment
  • Share recommendations and insights from the field to improve offerings for the hotel segment 

Requirements

Who are we looking for?

  • 4+ years of experience in hotel sales or hospitality tech, with a strong understanding of how hotel operators, revenue managers, and OTAs make decisions - Ideally, you’ve sold tech solutions (like RMS, channel managers, or booking engines) to hotel groups.
  • Preferred to have Native Spanish or French proficiency and Fluency in English.
  • A strong knack for sales - you genuinely enjoy connecting with people, understanding their needs, and helping them find solutions that create long-term value
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility with clients
  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset, with the ability to interpret trends and support revenue growth strategies
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, stay organised while managing multiple priorities, and collaborate well with others
  • Naturally curious and always learning, excited about building something new while helping bring structure and consistency to the process

How to apply for this position?

Please fill out the form with the required details. If your profile is shortlisted, our team will reach out to you via email. If you don't find the emails in your inbox, please check your spam folder.

Tip: Avoid using AI-generated responses. We want to hear from you!

jobs.title: German Solutions Consultant - Mid Market (Remote)
jobs.description:
About the Role:

We're looking for a Mid-Market Solutions Consultant based in Europe to help expand our presence in the German markets.
In the role, you'll work with our growing Mid-Market team to engage with small to mid-sized property managers and support them through their initial discovery of PriceLabs to becoming active users.

The role operates during CET hours (9:30 AM to 6:30 PM CET / 1 PM to 10:00 PM Indian Standard Time), focusing primarily on converting smaller to mid-sized inbound prospects.

This role is available to individuals residing in Germany, Austria, Spain or Portugal who hold a valid work permit.

Compensation: €30,000 – €40,000 per year (total compensation, including base salary and variable pay), depending on experience and location.

Key responsibilities:

  • Serving as the primary point of contact for new small to mid-sized property managers throughout their onboarding process   
  • Driving conversions of new prospects by conducting compelling and detailed virtual product demonstrations 
  • Assist new prospects in setting up their PriceLabs accounts and optimize their PriceLabs usage as per their unique revenue management strategies and preferences.
  • Clearly and effectively communicating PriceLabs’ value proposition to potential clients
  • Consistently meeting & exceeding performance expectations
  • Collaborate with the Sales ops team to update and maintain key information and history associated with onboarded mid-size accounts on the CRM  
  • Facilitate knowledge transfer and smooth handover of selective onboarded accounts that grow beyond mid-size by collaborating with the sales-ops team and In-market Solution Consultants to ensure dedicated account management

Requirements

About You:

  • Proven experience (2-3+ years) as an Account Executive, in Customer Success, or in other sales/customer-facing roles, preferably in a SaaS company
  • Fluent in German and English (verbal and written)
  • Adept at conducting product walk-throughs over video calls and effectively communicating a product’s value and ROI to clients
  • A track record of achieving defined sales performance metrics
  • Data-driven, analytical, and quantitative mindset
  • Excellent communication/presentation skills and ability to build relationships
  • Exceptionally well-organized and good with time-management skills
  • Experience with the short-term rental market and managing US/European clients is a plus

How to apply for this position?

Please fill out the form with the required details. If your profile is shortlisted, our team will reach out to you via email. If you don't find the emails in your inbox, please check your spam folder. 
Tip: Avoid using AI-generated responses. We want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Graphic Designer - Marketing (Remote)
jobs.description:
Note: We are only open to Individuals who reside in India for this position. 

We are seeking an innovative, forward-thinking Senior Graphic Designer to join our Marketing Design team as an AI-native design specialist. This is a dedicated Individual Contributor (IC) role focused on driving design excellence, visual depth, and campaign innovation by leveraging modern design technology and AI-augmented workflows.

In this role, you will be the hands-on creator behind our most critical marketing assets - from high-stakes campaign visuals and interactive industry reports to brand identity evolutions. As our design team’s AI power-user, you will test and adopt advanced AI tools into your daily creation workflow to elevate visual depth, speed, and output volume. If you excel at pushing creative boundaries using AI-assisted tools while maintaining high human artistic standards in your own craft, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • High-Impact Execution & Strategic Prioritization: Own the visual strategy and hands-on execution for flagship marketing campaigns, major reports, and tier-1 brand initiatives. Strategically maneuver between competing projects to minimize negative impact and suggest scope trade-offs to balance tight deadlines.
  • Agile Creative Delivery & Iteration: Break down complex creative briefs into manageable chunks, launch rapid design MVPs/concepts, and iterate based on real feedback until performance results are achieved.
  • AI-Augmented Design & Innovation: Integrate advanced AI tools (e.g., automated design critiques, generative visual modeling, brand guideline validation) into your daily workflows. Target new AI-driven methods to solve longstanding design challenges and facilitate creative innovation across marketing.
  • Data Fluency & Performance Optimization: Bring design performance data to tactical and strategic discussions. Continually measure audience responsiveness to design through metrics and adapt assets based on direct performance insights.
  • System Design & Influencing Quality: Establish design quality standards, asset template systems, and brand guidelines that influence how other teams approach design, enabling junior designers and marketers to maintain brand consistency effortlessly.
  • Ownership & Proactive Communication: Take full ownership of critical creative decisions. Communicate clearly through documentation and guides, build trusted working relationships with marketing leadership, and maintain proactive communication with all team partners.
  • Team Uplift & Collaborative Attitude: Maintain a positive, problem-solving attitude during fast-paced challenges, helping elevate the overall team's delivery quality through peer sharing and exemplary execution.

Requirements

  • Proven Senior Experience: 5+ years of professional design experience in a fast-paced SaaS or tech marketing environment (In-house SaaS/tech background required; agency experience excluded).
  • Autonomy & Prioritization: Proven track record of independently breaking down abstract briefs, managing scope constraints, and driving high-impact initiatives from concept through execution.
  • Data Fluency: Practical experience bringing data/metrics into creative discussions and demonstrating how design iterations directly improved campaign results.
  • AI & Tool Mastery: Deep practical expertise in Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, and generative AI tools/frameworks (e.g., Claude, Midjourney, Photoshop Generative Fill, Figma AI, or custom prompts) to accelerate output speed and visual depth.
  • Agile Execution Mindset: Comfort with launching early visual concepts (MVPs) quickly and systematically iterating based on user response and feedback.
  • Exceptional Communication & Documentation: Ability to document design approaches, build clear visual guidelines, articulate creative decisions confidently to leadership, and partner seamlessly across distributed teams.
  • Growth & Expertise Orientation: Deep curiosity for design technology and marketing trends, actively pursuing deeper domain expertise and sharing insights with peers.

How to apply for this position?

Please fill out the form with the required details. If your profile is shortlisted, our team will reach out to you via email. If you don't find the emails in your inbox, please check your spam folder.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Analyst (Remote)
jobs.description:
Note: We are only open to Individuals who reside in India for this position. 


About the Role:

Our marketing team runs on data across paid acquisition, field marketing and events, affiliate, and content/SEO. None of it means anything until someone turns it into a decision. This role owns that translation.

  • Owning marketing dashboards and datasets across every channel, including the ETL underneath them
  • Building and maintaining multiple attribution views (first-touch, last-touch), and understanding precisely why they disagree
  • Writing Python ETL that survives upstream systems changing underneath it
  • Root-causing anomalies before they reach a stakeholder
  • Turning results into recommendations the marketing team can act on
  • Distrusting your own numbers by default and checking them before anyone else has to
  • Explaining why two valid ways of measuring the same thing disagree, not just reporting both and moving on
  • Using AI tools to move faster, while always knowing when to double-check the output. We run on agentic BI workflows here and expect you to direct them, not just accept whatever comes back
  • Preferring to say "I don't trust this number yet" in a meeting over shipping something polished but wrong

Requirements

About You:

  • 3–5 years in analytics, marketing analytics, or data analyst roles, ideally with direct marketing/growth exposure
  • Strong SQL — comfortable reading and writing complex, multi-CTE queries, and tracing logic through unfamiliar views without a data dictionary
  • Python for data pipelines — not just scripting, but building something a teammate could run again next month
  • Experience with a BI tool at the dataset/semantic-layer level (Superset, Looker, Tableau, Mode) — building metrics and datasets, not only charts
  • Working knowledge of marketing attribution concepts (first-touch, last-touch, multi-touch) and their trade-offs
  • Demonstrated stakeholder communication — you've presented findings to non-technical audiences and adjusted the story, not just the slide design

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery and Apache Superset
  • Proven track record of owning analytics across diverse marketing channels, beyond just paid acquisition
  • Practical experience integrating and directing AI agents or tools within production technical workflows, beyond basic conversational assistance

Benefits

About PriceLabs:

PriceLabs is a revenue management solution for the short-term rental and hospitality industry, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Chicago, IL. Our platform helps individual hosts and hospitality professionals optimize their pricing and revenue management, adapting to changing market trends and occupancy levels.

With dynamic pricing, automation rules, and customizations, we manage pricing and minimum-stay restrictions for any portfolio size, with prices automatically uploaded to preferred channels.

Every day, we price over 700,000+ listings globally across 150+ countries, offering world-class tools like the Base Price Help and Minimum Stay Recommendation Engine.

In 2026, we scaled to;

  • 700K+ listings
  • 160+ integrations
  • 150+ countries
  • 300+ globally remote team
  • 80K+ customers worldwide
  • 40% diversity


Industry awards won:

  • SaasBoomi 2021
  • The Shortyz 2020
  • The Shortyz 2023
  • STRive Awards 2025
  • STRive Awards 2026

We continue to grow exponentially, backed by a strong team to take us to the next level.

 

Why join PriceLabs?

  • Work with an industry-leading product that has thousands of customers worldwide, and our customers love the product! (NPS in the 70s, Customer reviews here)
  • Work with a global team (18 countries and counting) of passionate individuals that accept open communication, empowerment, and a shared focus on customer success.
